name: Oka National Park
policyReason: Sépaq allows dogs on a few named trails, mainly north of route des Collines, and in three campground loops.
summary: Dogs are allowed mainly north of route des Collines: on a few trails, three campground loops and two picnic areas.

excerpts.quote: Les chiens sont admis principalement du côté nord de la route des Collines et dans trois boucles de camping du côté sud.

dogRules.text: Summer trails: L'Érablière, Le Calvaire d'Oka, La Vagabonde (Route verte), Le Sommet.
Winter trails: Le Calvaire d'Oka, Le Sommet, Le Marais (north section), Chemin des Collines.
Camping Le Refuge loops 1–3 and parts of La Crête (summer only).
Picnic areas: Calvaire d'Oka and Grande-Baie.
No dogs on the water (nautical access).
